title: Product-brief distillate frontmatter
description: Structural contract for `_context/planning/product-brief-v{N}.md`. Product-brief is a Phase 2 distillate (not a sacred doc) — it is regeneratable and versioned, not governance-locked.

tier.description: Always `distillate` — distinguishes product-brief from sacred docs.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version number. Matches the `v{N}` suffix in the filename.

status.description: `draft` while the skill is mid-run; `authored` on user acceptance; `superseded` when a higher-version brief replaces this one.

derived_from.description: `synthesis` when input was `research-synthesis-v{N}.md`; `research-fragments` when synthesis was skipped and raw research fragments were used directly.

synthesis_version.description: Version N of the `research-synthesis-vN.md` this brief was derived from. Null if `derived_from` is `research-fragments`.

validation_version.description: Version N of the `idea-validation-vN.md` this brief incorporated. Null if validate-idea was skipped.

red_flag_disposition.description: Populated if validate-idea Step 9 raised a red flag. Null if no red flag.
